label: Whatever is CONTAINED_IN_1 a bearer without being a real constituent of it is apprehended by it
paraphrase: OPEN conceptualist premise about non-real being, analyst formulation, attribution deferred (related to the classical dictum that beings of reason have being only in an intellect; Augustine, Leibniz and Plantinga are navigation only): for every bearer b and item e, if e is contained in b (CONTAINED_IN_1) and is not a real constituent of b, then b itself apprehends e. It is general: it mentions no favouring, value or root. It entails that a bearer that apprehends nothing contains no non-real item. It is not a consequence of the dictum: it drops the dependence modality (weaker) but indexes apprehension to the bearer that contains the item (stronger, since the dictum allows apprehension by some other intellect), and it ranges over every non-real contained item rather than over beings of reason, so the dictum reaches A4's modes only if every non-real item is a being of reason, which A4 denies. Warrant for the dictum bears at most on apprehension by some apprehender; a dictum-faithful sibling would need a root bridge that nothing other than the root can apprehend an item contained in it before production, which is not registered. Its denial is the claim that some bearer contains a non-real item mind-independently: on the noncognitive imitability-exemplar rival (A4) the modes of imitability of a simple nature; on a Scotist reading, formalities distinguished a parte rei but not really. It is strictly stronger than the root cognition criterion given the other premises of its derivation (Comparator companion rootCriterionWithoutConceptualism); restricted to the root route it would be equivalent to that criterion.
